description: Trained YOLOv8 object detector preserved from the original project. Its weights are unchanged; it supports Grade A and Grade B only.

runtime_defaults.notes: Operational thresholds are tuned for dense tray images and can be overridden with MODEL_* / USE_TILED / TILE_* environment variables.

grading_methodology.supported_grades_source: Derived at runtime from the loaded checkpoint's own class names. GradeC/GradeD are reported only if the checkpoint actually contains those classes.
grading_methodology.image_level_grade: The majority detected grade becomes the image-level grade; ties favour the better grade (A > B > C > D). No grade is invented for classes the model does not contain.
grading_methodology.confidence: Mean confidence of detections in the winning grade class, reported as a percentage. This is not a calibrated probability.
grading_methodology.quality_score: Documented heuristic composition score using weights A=1.0, B=0.5, C=0.25, D=0.0 over model-supported grades only. It is not a model output or a laboratory result.
grading_methodology.unsupported_grades: Grade C and Grade D are not evaluated by this checkpoint. They are shown as unsupported rather than relabelled from A/B predictions.

capabilities.notes: Bounding boxes can be used only for image-space size/aspect estimates. Black-spot, crack, mold, and discoloration detection are not supported by this model. The application supports four-grade checkpoints without code changes.

training.promotion: Only scripts/train_model.py --promote copies a candidate over weights/best.pt, after a supplied evaluation report and baseline comparison. The active model is backed up first.

evaluation.reason: No verified held-out evaluation report or labelled evaluation dataset is bundled with this preserved artifact. Metrics are intentionally not fabricated. Use scripts/evaluate_model.py with a labelled YOLO dataset to generate evaluation/metrics.json.

known_limitations: The bundled checkpoint detects Grade A and Grade B only.
No defect, crack, mold, discoloration, or physical-size model is bundled.
Grade C/D become available only when an installed checkpoint whose class names include GradeC/GradeD is active.
The public Kaggle datasets inspected for this project provide image-level ripeness/plant-disease folders, not individual-nut grade bounding boxes.
The alwyndsouza21092 datasets provide individual-nut boxes labelled only areca_fruit. They can train a nut localizer, not the GradeA/GradeB/GradeC/GradeD head.
